models: Audi A4 / VW Passat / Skoda Octavia
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri/Connectors from/to Rear Lid Control Module (J605)
Internal electrical fault with Rear Lid Control Module (J605)
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin: /Repair Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri/Connectors from/to Rear Lid Control Module (J605)
Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  failed Rear Lid Control Module (J605)

Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: 3C-Passat, Değiştirin / Yenileyin: Rear Lid Control Module (J605)
Note: Damage to this controller/motor maybe due to an obstruction during the opening/closing operation of the rear lid.
Important! - After replacing Rear Lid Control Module (J605), Adaptasyon / Kalibrasyon:  must be performed.
Rear lid is manually positioned in the halfway position, then both the outside and inside lid buttons are depressed at the same time. The lid will then move to the fully up position, adaptation is now complete, Kontrol edin: clear codes.
The 'Motor in rear lid control module (V375)' is part of the 'Rear Lid Control Module (J605)'
